claims.text: The SAML assertion signature verification failed, indicating a mismatch or corruption in the signature provided by the IdP.
The signing certificate thumbprint was verified and matches the expected configuration.
The Identity Provider successfully reported a status of success in the SAML response.
We identified duplicate attribute names in the assertion, which may cause compatibility issues with certain SAML libraries.

fix_steps: Verify that the Identity Provider is signing the SAML assertion using the correct private key corresponding to the public certificate pinned in our service.
Ensure that no intermediate proxies or security appliances are modifying the SAML response body, as this will invalidate the cryptographic signature.
Review the Identity Provider configuration to ensure that the signing algorithm matches the expected standards.
parsed.summary: We have investigated the SSO login failures reported by your users. Our analysis indicates that the SAML assertion provided by your Identity Provider contains an invalid digital signature, which prevents our system from securely verifying the authentication response.
